full_judgment:
7. The Managing Director as well as a shareholder of the Company has filed this CPLA contending, inter alia that the notice pursuant to which the resolution was passed for winding up of the Company was not served upon the Managing Director and three shareholders of the Company as required under section 87(2) of the Act. The leave-petitioner is the Managing Director as well as a shareholder of the Company but he was not informed about the intention of some other shareholders for winding up of the Company. No notice was given to him relating to the proceeding for winding up of the Company. The Company matter also suffers from non-joiner and mis-joinder of the parties as the application was filed with-out making Sirajul Islam shareholder of the Company as a partly to the proceeding and no notice was served to him .Md. Karimuddin Bahrasha was a fugitive in the eye of law was warrant of arrest was issued in his name, which was in force and as such he was not entitled the impugned judgment/order were obtained from the Court fraudulently behind the back of the Managing Director as well as some share-holders of the Company. Thus, the impugned judgment and order are erroneous and fraudulently obtained from the court and, as such, liable to be set-aside. 

 (3) The application has been filed by the application without making Serajul Islam. Md.Saidul Islam and Md. Kabirul Islam significant shareholder of the Company as parties in the proceedings before the High Court Division and so, the matter suffers from non-joinder and mis-joinder of parties. Moreover, notice was not also served upon the leave petitioner personally being a shareholder in the Company being a shareholder in the Company. Hence he impugned judgment and order is unlawful.
